evals.name: hud-layout-and-touch
evals.prompt: 我的微信小游戏（竖屏，原生 canvas，没用引擎）在 iPhone 14 上分数被右上角胶囊按钮挡住了，而且画面有点糊。帮我写一个 js/hud.js 模块：负责初始化主 canvas，顶部显示分数和一个暂停按钮，底部放一个开始按钮，并处理这些按钮的点击（要支持多指，手指滑走不算点击）。把最终代码写到 outputs/hud.js，并在 outputs/notes.md 里简短说明你的布局依据。
evals.expected_output: A module that uses the real menu button rect, handles a missing safeArea, scales the canvas by pixel ratio and reads changedTouches.
expectations: Uses wx.getMenuButtonBoundingClientRect to position UI
Does not hardcode the menu button size as the primary source
Uses wx.getWindowInfo rather than only wx.getSystemInfoSync
Guards against safeArea being absent
Sets canvas size using pixelRatio and applies a context scale or transform
Reads changedTouches when handling touch end
Handles wx.onTouchCancel without treating it as a tap

evals.name: friend-leaderboard
evals.prompt: Add a friends leaderboard to my WeChat mini game. I have a working main canvas game loop in game.js with `ctx` and `requestAnimationFrame`. Write everything needed: the game.json change, the main-game code, and the open data context code. Put the files in outputs/ (outputs/game.json, outputs/leaderboard-main.js, outputs/open-data/index.js) and list anything I must also set up in outputs/notes.md.
evals.expected_output: An open data context leaderboard that draws on the shared canvas, redraws it from the main loop and guards missing data.
expectations: game.json declares openDataContext
The open data code gets its canvas from wx.getSharedCanvas
The open data code does not draw the ranking on a canvas from wx.createCanvas
The main game draws the shared canvas repeatedly in the frame loop rather than once
Guards against a friend having an empty or missing KVDataList entry
The notes mention scope.WxFriendInteraction or the privacy policy requirement
The notes or code mention restrictions on the main canvas once open data is enabled

evals.name: share-ads-and-payment
evals.prompt: 我们的微信小游戏要加三个功能：1）通关后点按钮分享给好友，分享成功就送 50 金币；右上角菜单也要能转发。2）看激励视频复活。3）商店里卖金币（虚拟支付），付款成功就加金币。请写 outputs/monetize.js，并在 outputs/notes.md 里说明上线前必须知道的限制和需要的后台配置。如果需求本身有问题请直接指出。
evals.expected_output: Correct share, rewarded ad and payment code, pushing back on share-success rewards and on granting currency from the client callback.
expectations: Calls wx.showShareMenu so the menu share entry is enabled
Does not pass success or fail callbacks to wx.shareAppMessage
Does not use a toGroup parameter
States that a share success cannot be detected, so the reward needs a different design
Grants the revive only when isEnded is true in rewardedAd.onClose
Retries with rewardedAd.load when show fails
Does not describe offerId as a product id
States buyQuantity must match fixed price tiers
States purchases must be confirmed by the server rather than the client callback
Decides iOS payment at runtime rather than assuming it is impossible
If it calls wx.checkIsSupportMidasPayment, it reads res.data.allow_pay
Mentions the eligibility requirements for virtual payment
Uses the server-signed requestMidasPaymentGameItem path with mode coins for currency and notes the API table conflict

evals.name: package-size-and-worker
evals.prompt: Our WeChat mini game can't upload: the whole project is 24MB, with 6MB of levels in stage2/ and stage3/, plus lots of .webp textures that look fine in DevTools. Also pathfinding is causing frame drops so I want to move it to an original Worker thread (no Worker V2 rollout access) that also reads saved settings with wx.getStorageSync. Tell me what to change. Write outputs/game.json, outputs/load-stage.js (loads a stage with a progress bar) and outputs/path-worker.js plus whatever main-thread code is needed, and put your explanation in outputs/notes.md.
evals.expected_output: Correct limits, subpackage loading, whitelist warning about webp, and a Worker that gets settings passed in rather than calling wx.
expectations: States the total package limit is 30MB, not 20MB
States the main package limit is 4MB
Does not claim a 2MB per-subpackage limit
game.json declares subpackages for the stages
game.json declares workers
Calls wx.loadSubpackage and uses onProgressUpdate
Warns that webp is not on the upload whitelist
Scopes the no-wx rule to the original Worker and passes settings by message
Scopes the one-Worker concurrency restriction to the original Worker

evals.name: starter-scaffolding
evals.prompt: 从零做一个原生 Canvas 微信小游戏：点击下落的水果得分，20 秒一局，记录最高分。输出可直接导入开发者工具的完整项目到 outputs/，无需构建或依赖。说明项目是如何从随附 starter 开始的，并替换示例玩法。
evals.expected_output: A runnable dependency-free project derived from assets/starter with replacement game rules and preserved platform services.
expectations: Uses the bundled assets/starter as the starting point and preserves its platform service behavior when the skill is supplied
Includes game.js game.json and project.config.json under outputs with compileType game
Replaces js/game with falling-fruit rules rather than shipping the unchanged Tap Rush sample
Keeps wx calls in platform modules or the entry point and game rules independent of wx
Requires no build step or runtime dependencies and uses CommonJS
Does not claim a DevTools or phone run without actual execution evidence

evals.name: audio-and-lifecycle
evals.prompt: Write outputs/audio.js for our WeChat mini game: looping BGM, overlapping hit sounds, mute and unmute, and cleanup when the game scene is replaced. Phone calls and backgrounding can end in either order. We also use iOS High Performance mode. Explain remaining phone checks in outputs/notes.md.
evals.expected_output: Pooled audio with separate visibility, interruption and user intent states, compatible backend choice and complete teardown.
expectations: Uses wx.createInnerAudioContext for BGM and reuses multiple voices for overlapping effects
Handles both wx.onHide/onShow and wx.onAudioInterruptionBegin/End
Does not resume playback on interruption end while the game remains hidden
Keeps music intent separate from muted state so unmuting does not restart deliberately paused music
Avoids unconditional useWebAudioImplement true in iOS High Performance mode
Restarts pooled effects with stop then play rather than seek then play
Removes owned global listeners and destroys audio contexts during cleanup including WebAudio close if used
Distinguishes mocked verification from real phone testing

evals.name: privacy-and-user-info
evals.prompt: 微信小游戏要在首页显示玩家头像昵称。请写 outputs/profile.js 和 outputs/notes.md，包含隐私弹窗、查看隐私政策、同意和拒绝、首次授权和已授权流程。玩家拒绝后也应该能玩。可以用 wx.getUserProfile 吗？
evals.expected_output: Privacy and native user-info authorization flow or display-only open data alternative without inventing getUserProfile.
expectations: Explains wx.getUserProfile is not a documented mini game API and does not call it
Reports exposureAuthorization when a custom privacy dialog is displayed through wx.onNeedPrivacyAuthorization
Opens the privacy policy using wx.openPrivacyContract
Resolves agree and disagree from real taps and permits play after refusal
Uses wx.createUserInfoButton for first scope.userInfo authorization or explicitly chooses display-only open data context
Checks existing authorization before wx.getUserInfo and does not expect wx.authorize to show a user-info dialog
Mentions MP privacy declarations and cleans up native user-info buttons and listeners

evals.name: engine-source-routing
evals.prompt: Our Cocos Creator WeChat export is 8MB and game.json resets after each build. Use the supplied source/export fixture to propose durable subpackaging and texture changes. Write outputs/notes.md with the source settings to inspect, rebuild validation, and the minimum additional information needed. Do not invent missing build settings or rewrite the game as raw canvas.
evals.expected_output: Engine source workflow with generated output boundaries and version-specific verification.
expectations: Recognizes Creator 3.8.7 and uses version-matched Cocos documentation
Makes durable changes through source assets bundle/build configuration rather than generated game.json
Preserves engine canvas loop audio and resource ownership
Does not claim an engine rebuild or device run without evidence
Identifies missing asset layout or build settings before prescribing exact bundles

evals.name: existing-hud-integration
evals.prompt: Fix the score hidden under the capsule in the supplied native WeChat game. Output outputs/js/hud.js and outputs/notes.md. Preserve the existing game.js canvas and loop; describe any required initialization changes. Respect small and landscape windows.
evals.expected_output: A HUD module using the existing canvas and logical coordinates with safe bounds.
expectations: Keeps the existing drawHud export and accepts the existing context and score
Does not create another main canvas or frame loop
Uses menu rectangle and window geometry without multiplying touch/layout coordinates by DPR
Handles missing safeArea and explains resize integration
Does not claim device verification from a fixture

evals.name: unavailable-docs-and-release
evals.prompt: The WeChat documentation reader returned HTTP 200 with <html>Site Unavailable</html>. Our team wants to enable Worker V2 on iOS, ship signed coins payment, and release today. Write outputs/notes.md with what can proceed, unresolved decisions, and the exact validation layers you can claim in this environment. You have not run DevTools or a phone.
evals.expected_output: Unavailable evidence is distinguished from drift and no release or rollout guarantees are invented.
expectations: Treats the error body as unavailable evidence rather than changed platform facts
Does not assume Worker V2 supports iOS or DevTools
Keeps payment eligibility agreement signatures and server reconciliation requirements
Includes version review and filing before release without promising approval timing
Does not claim DevTools phone or live payment validation
